releaseNotes:
v6.5.0 — Sleep Timer, YouTube Music Search Overhaul & Player UI Polish

Player & Controls:
• Added Sleep Timer directly to player controls with 15, 30, and 60 minute presets plus custom duration support and live countdown badge
• Redesigned the Shuffle button across the player, queue sheet, and playlist header by removing the circular bubble background for a cleaner, minimal look

YouTube Music Search:
• Fixed YouTube Music search results so full searches match the accuracy of live search suggestions
• Unwrapped nested section shelves and separated official audio tracks (ATV) from user-uploaded videos (UGC/OMV) and podcast episodes
• Added relevance ranking that prioritizes official tracks and demotes unrelated slowed/reverb/karaoke uploads unless explicitly searched

Updates & Maintenance:
• Bumped app version to 6.5.0 (build 9) with in-app update notification support for older versions
